title: feat(plugin-chatbot): Airtable-style floating chatbot FAB widget with console integration
body:
Adds a floating action button (FAB) chatbot widget that renders as a fixed-position trigger button opening a chat panel overlay via React portal — enabling chatbot access from any page without occupying layout space. Integrated into the console application so the FAB is available on every authenticated page with metadata-aware context.

### Types (`@object-ui/types`)
- Extended `ChatbotSchema` with `displayMode: 'inline' | 'floating'` and `floatingConfig: FloatingChatbotConfig`
- New `FloatingChatbotConfig` interface: `position`, `defaultOpen`, `panelWidth`, `panelHeight`, `title`, `triggerIcon`, `triggerSize`

### Components (`@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`)
- **`FloatingChatbotProvider`** — React context managing `isOpen`/`isFullscreen` state; exposes `useFloatingChatbot()` hook for programmatic control
- **`FloatingChatbotTrigger`** — Fixed-position circular FAB with configurable corner and size
- **`FloatingChatbotPanel`** — Overlay panel with header (title, fullscreen toggle, close), `role="dialog"`, configurable dimensions
- **`FloatingChatbot`** — Orchestrator rendering via `ReactDOM.createPortal` to `#floating-chatbot-portal` to avoid z-index conflicts; wraps `ChatbotEnhanced`
- Registered as `chatbot-floating` in `ComponentRegistry`

### Console Integration (`@object-ui/console`)
- Added `ConsoleFloatingChatbot` to `ConsoleLayout.tsx` inside `AppShell`, making the FAB available on every authenticated page
- Wired with `useObjectChat` for metadata-aware auto-responses — injects current app name and object list into chatbot context
- Demo auto-response mode by default; switchable to API streaming when an `api` endpoint is configured

### Usage

Schema-driven:
```ts
const schema: ChatbotSchema = {
  type: 'chatbot',
  displayMode: 'floating',
  floatingConfig: {
    position: 'bottom-right',
    defaultOpen: false,
    panelWidth: 400,
    panelHeight: 520,
    title: 'Assistant',
  },
  messages: [],
  autoResponse: true,
};
```

Composable:
```tsx
<FloatingChatbotProvider defaultOpen={false}>
  <FloatingChatbotTrigger position="bottom-right" />
  <FloatingChatbotPanel title="Assistant" width={400} height={520}>
    <ChatbotEnhanced {...chatProps} />
  </FloatingChatbotPanel>
</FloatingChatbotProvider>
```

### Tests
- 21 new tests (7 provider state/hook, 14 trigger+panel interaction/a11y)
- All 66 plugin-chatbot tests pass

### Other
- Added `react/jsx-runtime` to vite externals for SSR compatibility
